map_view.theme: Dark map style (Google Maps night mode JSON)
map_view.instructions: Use custom map styling to match the #0A0A0A background. Roads should be dark grey, water should be deep charcoal, and route lines should use the primary color #F5B72E. Hide unnecessary POIs.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use NativeWind for Tailwind CSS styling in the React Native Expo app.
Ensure all critical buttons (like 'Accept Mission', 'Navigate') have a minimum height of 56dp (h-14) for easy tapping while driving.
Implement 'Slide to Confirm' interactions for status changes (assigned → en_route → arrived) using React Native Reanimated & Gesture Handler.
For the Map screen, use react-native-maps with a custom dark mode JSON style. The map is the primary hub, so the 'Go Online' toggle should float prominently over the map.

Add 'data-testid' to all interactive and key informational elements for automated testing (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='slide-confirm-assigned'). If Native components strip it, ensure 'testID' is mapped correctly.
Use the brand primary color #F5B72E specifically for key actions and highlights (Go Online, New Mission Alert, Earnings value). Use high-contrast #0A0A0A for text when placed inside a #F5B72E button.
Keep cognitive load low. Use large font sizes and bold weights for crucial info (Price, Distance, Passenger Name). Avoid clutter.
